# GISCO/NUTS fixtures (BE-59 NRW scope)

Reduced excerpts in the official GISCO 2024 column layouts. NRW rows (`DEA*`)
use real NUTS codes and postcodes from the pinned extract; Baden-Württemberg and
Finland rows remain so tests prove that out-of-scope regions and postcodes are
not emitted. Identifiers beyond the selected columns are illustrative.
